keyValue.key: Default column label of a table of name and value rows (for example a header name).
keyValue.value: Default column label of a table of name and value rows.
keyValue.type: Column label of the Text or File choice of a multipart form row.
keyValue.sendRow: Accessible label of the checkbox that enables a row.
keyValue.fieldType: Accessible label of the Text or File picker of a multipart row.
keyValue.text: Option: the value of the row is text. Not the same as the Text body type.
keyValue.file: Option: the value of the row is a file.
keyValue.bulkLabel: {{keyLabel}} is the name of the kind of row, such as Header or Parameter.
keyValue.bulkPlaceholder: {{keyLabel}} is the name of the kind of row; the text shows the name: value format.
keyValue.bulkHint: Keep // and # as given; they are comment markers.
keyValue.editAsTable: Button that returns from the text view to the table view.
keyValue.bulkEdit: Button that switches the table to a text area with one row per line.
